notification_digest:
Existing required behavior
Update NotificationPipeline so consecutive publish calls made before flush are grouped by actor into one delivered message. Add flush; it sends pending messages in first-seen actor order, joins that actor's message texts with '; ', and emits nothing for an empty buffer. Preserve the current actor/message format. Calls after a flush start a new batch.

New request
Make flush return the number of actor messages it delivered. An empty flush returns 0, and a repeated flush after delivery also returns 0.
regional_policy:
Existing required behavior
Keep the regional quote rules correct. North charges $4 plus $1.50 per kg and becomes free at subtotal $50 or above. South delivery estimates charge $6 plus $1 per kg and become free at subtotal $75 or above. Checkout follows the same southern base and weight rule, adds its existing $1 handling charge, and uses the $75 free-shipping threshold. Thresholds are inclusive; below each threshold, apply the applicable charges.

New request
Verify the exact free-shipping boundaries and amounts immediately below them in both public quote flows. Checkout adds a $2 handling charge to its existing $1 southern handling fee only when the southern parcel weighs less than 2 kg; exactly 2 kg does not receive the extra $2. The $75 south free-shipping threshold waives every charge. Delivery estimates never include checkout handling charges.
archive_export:
Existing required behavior
Make ArchiveExporter publish atomically: if writing the header, any row, or finishing raises, no partial archive is visible and a later call can retry. A successful export publishes once; subsequent calls return :already_exported and do not write again. Propagate the original writer error.

New request
Allow callers to publish the same source to another writer using `export_to(writer)`. Each writer tracks completion independently: a failed attempt on the second writer is retryable, and completing it must not cause the already-completed default writer to publish again. A new writer receives the same source rows on its first attempt. Preserve the original writer error and keep the completion state for one writer from affecting any other writer.
